subject.title: Generalize post-timeout compaction completion reconciliation across session state

question: Should OpenClaw promote the existing count-only compaction success repair into an authoritative compaction-completion reconciliation boundary, and which session fields may it own?
rationale: The remaining work changes core session-state ownership across runner completion, status snapshots, memory/auth markers, and possibly channel recovery, so source inspection cannot choose the permanent product boundary safely.

options.title: Scope a narrow core boundary
options.body: Create one reconciliation helper/event for compaction-derived durable fields only, starting with counters and trustworthy token snapshots, with idempotent writes and tests.

options.title: Keep targeted repairs separate
options.body: Leave the current count-only reconciler in place and handle status/outcome/activity gaps as individual issues or PRs.

options.title: Wait for live repro
options.body: Keep this issue open but require a concrete current-main mismatch before approving broader session-state architecture work.

recommendation.title: Scope a narrow core boundary
recommendation.body: Create one reconciliation helper/event for compaction-derived durable fields only, starting with counters and trustworthy token snapshots, with idempotent writes and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They reviewed/coauthored the original narrow reconciliation fix and are the clearest routing candidate for deciding whether that boundary should expand.
